<!-- All news items below this line -->
;Armed conflicts and attacks
*[[War in Afghanistan (2001–present)|War in Afghanistan]]
**Dozens of people are killed in four separate attacks by the [[Taliban]]. An [[Afghan National Army|army base]] is destroyed in [[Baghlan Province]]. [https://www.nytimes.com/2018/09/09/world/asia/afghanistan-military-base-attack.html (''The New York Times'')]

;Business and economy
*[[Weinstein effect]]
**[[Les Moonves]] resigns as CEO of [[CBS Corporation]] amid reports of sexual misconduct allegations and an ongoing investigation into his behavior. CBS donates $20 million to groups supporting the [[Me Too movement]] and states that this money may be deducted from Moonves' severance package depending on the investigation's results. [https://money.cnn.com/2018/09/09/media/les-moonves-cbs/index.html (CNN)]

;Disasters and accidents
*A small aircraft en route from [[Juba]] to [[Yirol]] crashes in [[South Sudan]], killing 20 people, including the [[Province of the Episcopal Church of South Sudan|Episcopal]] Bishop of [[Yirol]], and injuring three others. [https://www.thestar.com/news/world/2018/09/09/20-dead-after-plane-crash-in-south-sudan.html (''Toronto Star'')]
*At least one person is killed and nearly 40 others are injured in a stampede at a football stadium in [[Madagascar]]. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-africa-45465970 (BBC)]
*[[Earthquakes in 2018]]
**A magnitude 6.5 earthquake strikes near [[Kirakira, Solomon Islands|Kirakira]], [[Solomon Islands]]. No tsunami warnings have been issued. [https://earthquake.usgs.gov/earthquakes/eventpage/us2000hbk9#executive (USGS)]
*[[President of Moldova|Moldovan President]] [[Igor Dodon]] is involved in a highway accident when his official [[motorcade]] is struck by a truck coming from the opposite direction. Several passengers, including the president and members of his family, suffer moderate injuries and are hospitalized. Reports indicate that the Moldovan head of state is in good health. [https://www.bbc.com/news/world-europe-45465598 (BBC)]

;International relations
*[[North Korea and weapons of mass destruction]], [[Public holidays in North Korea]]
**[[North Korea]] celebrates its [[Day of the Foundation of the Republic (North Korea)|70th anniversary]] with a military parade in [[Pyongyang]] with the absence of its [[Intercontinental ballistic missile|international ballistic]] [[Korean People's Army Strategic Force#Active missiles|missiles]]. [https://www.nytimes.com/2018/09/09/world/asia/north-korea-parade-missiles.html (''The New York Times'')]

;Law and crime
*About 200 [[Kosovo Albanian]] veterans from the [[Kosovo War]] block the road to [[Banja, Skenderaj|Banje]] near [[Drenica]] and prevent a planned visit by the [[President of Serbia]]. [https://www.reuters.com/article/idUSKCN1LP05Q (Reuters)] [https://apnews.com/9e364cfbbb7f4028b5d8cd11b55c5569 (Associated Press)] 
*The prosecutor in [[Abkhazia]] says that the driver of the car that probably initiated the deadly accident of [[Prime Minister of Abkhazia]] [[Gennadi Gagulia|Gennady Gagulya]] yesterday was under the influence of drugs and has been detained. [https://news.am/eng/news/470103.html (News.am)]
*Seven people, including two [[United Kingdom|British]] tourists, are wounded in a knife attack in the [[19th arrondissement of Paris|19th arrondissement]] of [[Paris]]. The attacker, said to be an [[Afghanistan|Afghan]] national, is arrested by police. [https://apnews.com/80f86426c5dc4179887eb4899e7b0b96 (Associated Press)] [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-45468082 (BBC)]

;Politics and elections
*[[Swedish general election, 2018]]
**Voters in [[Sweden]] head to the polls to elect members to the [[Riksdag]]. [https://www.bbc.co.uk/news/world-europe-45461686 (BBC)]
**[[Media of Sweden|Swedish media]] report [[Voter intimidation|voter harassment]] by members of the neo-Nazi [[Nordic Resistance Movement]]. The far-right [[Alternative for Sweden]] party is reportedly "shouting loud" on social media. [https://www.washingtonpost.com/business/the-latest-voters-appear-split-in-sweden-election/2018/09/09/de3f618e-b430-11e8-ae4f-2c1439c96d79_story.html (''The Washington Post'')]

;Sports
*[[2018 NFL season]]
**The [[Green Bay Packers]] won a game down 17 or more in the fourth quarter for the first time in [[History of the Green Bay Packers|their history]] with a 24-23 win over the [[Chicago Bears]] after [[Aaron Rodgers]] returned from an injury that caused him to temporarily leave the game. This win was the “fourth-largest” comeback in their [[History of the Green Bay Packers|team history]]. [https://sports.yahoo.com/five-craziest-stats-packers-unbelievable-comeback-bears-051422404.html (Sports Yahoo)] [https://www.businessinsider.com/aaron-rodgers-packers-comeback-over-bears-2018-9 (''Business Insider'')]
